prompt:
Create one finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 poster for a community digital screen, inviting adult neighbors to a relaxed evening of seasonal food and local music.

Build a continuous illustrated courtyard gathering in one oblique viewpoint. Its visual center is the shared act of eating while listening: a close, generously cropped serving bowl of spring-greens soup enters at the lower-right and right edges, with a ladle, small dishes and reusable cups. Behind this foreground, seated adult neighbors of varied ages form a single receding diagonal toward an informal flute player farther left. Their bodies, chairs, table edges and shared sightlines connect the meal to the music. The musician is one neighbor at the gathering, modest in scale. Show clear hands holding bowls or cups and a physically coherent flute held at the mouth with both hands. Use anonymous invented people and an unbranded neighborhood setting.

Draw this as crisp digital ink narrative with selective luminous color washes: expressive but economical blue-green contours, finer and fewer lines in the distance, denser linework on the cropped soup and nearby sleeves, clean silhouettes and deliberate overlaps. The sequence of foreground rim → listeners → distant player should shape the whole frame. Amber light touches faces, soup steam and dishes; fresh greens identify the seasonal food. Deep blue-green interlocking silhouettes and warm pale open pockets create a varied image field, with small courtyard plant contours connecting the edges. This is a drawn scene and integrated lettering, with clean digital finish, not aged paper.

Design image and information together. The asymmetric sweep of the bowl, table and listeners creates an inner bend left of center for the conversational Korean title, written in a highly legible broad-pen style with open Hangul counters and stable word spacing. A compact English companion and the event description sit close beneath it. The date and event hours form a short horizontal two-line stop above the title. Venue and arrival time occupy a different, smaller contour-defined pocket near the upper-right gathering; admission and participation belong directly beneath that stop. The cup reminder sits beside the near cups, and the lingering invitation lies along the listening group toward the lower-left. Use stable horizontal baselines, clear medium humanist sans for practical Korean, distinct tabular numerals, and comfortable line spacing. Give every practical line enough size and contrast to read at a 720-pixel-wide display. Keep contours, washes and hatching out of letter counters and away from punctuation. Use warm pale lettering on dark gathered silhouettes and dark teal lettering in light contour openings. These unequal pockets are interleaved with the narrative, without rectangular information panels or a common full-width footer.

The picture's changing scale, cropped foreground and connected adult actions must organize the composition. Exclude the passive solid/near-solid/split-color headline-and-information template with subordinate images, including an empty wall, floor, sky or room manufactured merely as a text-bearing panel. Preserve a substantial content-grounded visual scene; no collage of separate activity pictures. Make one poster only, without a border mockup, contact sheet, identifiable real business or performer promotion, logos, watermark, QR, invented writing or additional printed words.

Print only the following copy, each entry exactly once, with exact spelling, word spaces, punctuation and case. Soft line wrapping may occur between words; the cup reminder may use two lines. The time range uses a clearly readable en dash and two colons.
